verdict.rationale: Insomnia's core app is open-source under Apache-2.0 and can be run locally, and features like Git Sync and self-hosted Mockbin mock servers let users avoid Insomnia's cloud entirely, but there is no first-party documentation of a self-hosted server/backend deployment for the full collaborative product (organizations, RBAC, sync) as an alternative to Insomnia Cloud. missing for 10: explicit self-hosted server/enterprise deployment docs, evidence of self-hosting the full collaboration backend, independent confirmation of a self-hosted install path.
